title: crataegus × media var. monoxyacantha
intro: Crataegus × media var. monoxyacantha, commonly known as Midland hawthorn, is a hybrid plant species in the rose family (Rosaceae) that is native to Europe and Western Asia. This plant has been traditionally used in folk medicine, where it is valued for its health benefits, including the potential to lower blood pressure, improve cardiovascular health, and boost the immune system. The therapeutic actions of Crataegus × media var. monoxyacantha are attributed to its ability to exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and vasodilatory effects, which contribute to its cardiovascular benefits. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
